IndiGo Flight Lands Safely After Engine Issue at Chennai Airport

An IndiGo flight carrying 224 passengers experienced an engine malfunction while en route from Kolkata to Chennai. A full emergency was declared at Chennai Airport as a precautionary measure. The aircraft landed safely, and all passengers disembarked without incident. The specific nature of the engine issue was not detailed.
